title: Are LLMs Empathetic to All? Investigating the Influence of Multi-Demographic Personas on a Model’s Empathy

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring shifts in affective and cognitive empathy scores (using EPITOME and NRC Emotion Intensity Lexicon) across user personas representing 8 cultural regions (e.g., Confucian, African-Islamic, English Speaking) compared to a neutral baseline.
Evaluating variations in model empathy and emotion intensity predictions for user personas across 6 age categories (from 0-17 to 55+), analyzing alignment with real-world emotional expression trends.

Assessing differences in empathetic responses and emotion attribution towards user personas defined by gender (male, female, non-binary, gender-queer), specifically examining stereotype reinforcement (e.g., anger intensity in males vs females).
